status: The Modwerk core implementing this interface is in development. Mods written for this interface link with it unchanged.

events.name: ev_tick
events.handler: void f(ctrl); set ctrl+0x20 to recompose

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS draws the screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(brain, KeyEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(brain, EncoderEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_voice_on
events.when: a voice's note-on in the render
events.handler: void f(voice, track, event); may change the pitch word

events.name: ev_hold
events.when: a track key held on its own
events.handler: int f(brain, event, track); none taken opens the Mod Menu

exports.purpose: Open a mod page from a key handler.
